criteria.description: Projection drift: when projectionManifestPath is given, recompute source_hash/file_hash and compare to the manifest entries (9-field schema_version-1 shape); missing output → error, hash drift → warning.
criteria.evidence: lane-c@3526abe src/adapters/spec-kitty-profile/projection.ts:40-49 declares the 9-field ProjectionEntry (profile_urn, source_layer, tool_key, output_path, format, file_hash, source_path, source_hash, projection_version); matching is by profile_urn never source_path (projection.ts:8-10); hash is SHA-256 hex over raw UTF-8 (projection.ts:13-14); output_path for a relative path resolves against the projection manifest file's parent's parent, documented at projection.ts:17-25 as the load-bearing subtlety (§7.2) — the naive base (manifest's own directory) would collapse the 1-error/1-warning vector to 2 errors, per the passing regression test in the 170-file/3599-test suite. Independently reproduced live: `broken-projection-manifest.yaml` run yields exactly 1 error (projection-output-missing) + 1 warning (projection-hash-drift), exit 1.

criteria.description: CLI: muster skprofile run <manifest> with global --mode/--json; exit 0/1/2 per house contract.
criteria.evidence: Independently reproduced all three exit codes live in lane-c@3526abe (after `pnpm build`): (1) `node dist/cli/index.js skprofile run fixtures/skprofile/manifest.yaml` → exit 0, 2 warnings/0 errors; (2) `node dist/cli/index.js skprofile run fixtures/skprofile/broken-manifest.yaml` → exit 1, exactly 13 findings (12 error, 1 warning); (3a) manifest path pointing at a nonexistent file → exit 2, stderr 'cannot read spec-kitty-profile manifest'; (3b) a manifest whose projectionManifestPath points at invalid JSON → exit 2, stderr 'spec-kitty-profile adapter run failed'. Both (3a)/(3b) reproduced manually via a constructed temp manifest, independent of tests/skprofile/cli.test.ts:86-121 which assert the same.

criteria.description: Every finding carries source.normative = the taxonomy rubric §clause, or the schema@SHA for FR-002.
criteria.evidence: lane-c@3526abe src/adapters/spec-kitty-profile/rubric.ts:108-118 defines an 11-entry RUBRIC_CITATION map (handoff-unresolved, handoff-asymmetric, reference-unresolved, reference-not-activated, activation-config-unrecognized-shape, context-source-missing, profile-id-illegal, profile-id-filename-mismatch, profile-id-collision, projection-output-missing, projection-hash-drift). rubric.ts:88-90 `citationFor()`'s parameter type explicitly excludes "schema-conformance-violation", "profile-parse-error", AND "profile-id-illegal" — a compile-time guard forcing profile-id-illegal call sites through profileIdIllegalCitation("charset"|"length") instead (identity.ts:17,38,49 confirms this call site). Independently reproduced live: every finding in both the real-18-profile run and the broken-fixture run carries a non-null `source.normative` string.
criteria.notes: KNOWN LIMITATION, not a defect: a single report mixes Ajv JSON Pointer path notation (e.g. `/profile-id`, from schema-conformance-violation findings — verified live: finding.path === "/profile-id") with dotted/raw path notation (e.g. `profile-id`, from the lints — verified live: profile-id-illegal finding.path === "profile-id", no leading slash). No spec artifact requires path-notation uniformity across finding kinds, and WP01's instruction mandates the raw form for non-Ajv findings. Recorded here as an accepted, documented limitation — not claimed as satisfied uniformity.
